en.name: AgentEarth: Finance, E‑commerce & Social Media Toolkit
en.description: Access specialized data and services across financial markets, e-commerce and social media, content generation, web search and scraping, academic papers and patents, maps, and more. With a single registration, you can access professional data across multiple domains without setting up each service separately—all at prices substantially discounted from official rates. The platform currently covers the following areas:Finance: Access market quotes, stock prices, candlestick charts, trading volumes, corporate financial data, financial reports, and fundamentals for Chinese A-shares and U.S. stocks. Coverage also includes mutual funds, ETFs, foreign exchange, exchange rates, Bitcoin, and other cryptocurrencies, supporting equity and company research, investment analysis, and market monitoring. Integrated financial data providers include Tushare and CoinGecko.Content Generation: Create AI-generated images, generate images from text or reference images, produce product visuals (such as images for Xiaohongshu posts) and posters, remove backgrounds, and render text in images. Capabilities also include image-to-video and text-to-video generation, digital avatar presenter videos, voiceovers, background music, and sound effects. The platform brings together ByteDance’s Dreamina (Jimeng), Seedream, and Seedance, alongside Kling, Qwen, Wan, Tencent Hunyuan, MiniMax / Hailuo AI, Zhipu GLM, Google Gemini / Nano Banana / Veo, OpenAI GPT Image / Whisper, Stable Diffusion, FLUX, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, and other models and tools for image production, video creation, and audio processing.Information Retrieval: Run keyword-based web searches, look up news, conduct industry research and in-depth investigations, and access SEO data, semantic search results, web content extraction, and scraping proxy services. Integrated providers include Perplexity, Tavily, Exa, Firecrawl, and Linkup. The platform also supports searches for research papers, academic literature, citation relationships, and patent information; social media content and data queries for X (Twitter), YouTube, and TikTok; and searches for GitHub repositories, code, and developer documentation.E-commerce: Access data related to Douyin, TikTok Shop, Taobao, Tmall, 1688, Amazon, Shopee, Temu, and other platforms. Services such as Chanmama, Kalodata, and Sorftime provide insights into products, stores, creators, livestreams, and sales performance, supporting product sourcing and selection for domestic and cross-border markets, supplier discovery, market research, and competitor analysis.Other Services: Access mapping and weather services such as Amap and QWeather, with support for place searches, geocoding, and global and local weather queries to assist with travel planning. Additional capabilities include optical character recognition (OCR), document parsing, content extraction from PDF, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files, and searches for film, television, and job-related information.

## 腾讯文档 MCP

官方远程 MCP 服务（https://docs.qq.com/openapi/mcp），可读写你的腾讯文档。

### 授权方式

1. 点击「连接」，弹窗内展示二维码；
2. 用手机微信 / QQ 扫码并确认授权；
3. 授权完成后自动连接，凭据仅保存在本机。

也可以在二维码弹窗里选择「在浏览器中打开」完成授权。

### 额度

个人免费额度以官方说明为准（https://docs.qq.com/open/auth/mcp.html），会员可享更高额度。
